newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta eases against mark in bout of profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Peseta eases against mark in bout of profit-taking.

text.p: The peseta eased slightly against the mark in afternoon trade in a small bout of profit-taking ahead of the weekend and month-end, traders said.
By 1700 GMT the peseta was trading at 84.50/53, after touching 84.41 earlier and compared with levels seen late on Wednesday of 84.61/64.
Traders said the peseta had gathered some strength in morning trade after losing ground on Wednesday.
But by the afternoon, traders were squaring positions ahead of the weekend.
Against the dollar, the peseta was trading at 138.34/37 compared with 138.93/03 late on Wednesday.
